meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会充当编排器:把代码库按功能拆成 Mermaid 流程图,找出跨功能的重复逻辑,提出统一架构方案,在 PATHFINDER-日期/ 目录下产出五个文件(功能清单、流程图、重复报告、统一方案、handoff 提示),不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说“find the ideal path”、要求统一重复系统,或想在重构前审计架构时触发;它从功能发现阶段开始。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 把这个代码库拆成按功能分组的流程图
say.note: 会先在仓库根目录生成 PATHFINDER-日期/ 目录

say.text: 找出这些功能之间重复的关注点
say.note: 产出带 file:line 证据的重复报告

say.text: 给出统一架构方案,并生成 /make-plan 提示
say.note: 方案由编排器自己写,并附可复制的手递提示

howto.what_en: Claude acts as orchestrator: maps the codebase into feature-grouped Mermaid flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns across features, proposes a unified architecture, and writes five files under PATHFINDER-<date>/. It writes no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to "find the ideal path," to unify duplicated systems, or to audit architecture before a refactor; it starts with feature discovery.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to map this codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts
say_en.note: Creates a PATHFINDER-<date>/ directory at repo root

say_en.text: Find the duplicated concerns across these features
say_en.note: Produces a duplication report citing file:line

say_en.text: Propose a unified architecture and generate /make-plan prompts
say_en.note: The orchestrator writes the proposal and handoff prompts
